subject: Implement per-channel asyncio dispatcher
description:
Build `capo/transport/dispatcher.py` — one asyncio worker per `channel_id` processing envelopes in arrival order; different channels run in parallel. Worker pipeline: resolve `user_id` from envelope (via `[users]` mapping), call `agent.run(text, history, deps)`, then `amc.send` and `amc.mark_read`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] One asyncio worker per `channel_id`; envelopes processed in arrival order per channel.
- [ ] Different channels run in parallel; queue depth bounded by `concurrency.queue_depth_max` (default 100 per channel; see §15.3).
- [ ] Worker resolves `user_id` from envelope sender via Settings `[users]` table; unknown senders are rejected at the dispatcher (logged as defense-in-depth alongside AMC allowlist).
- [ ] Worker calls `amc.send` then `amc.mark_read` after agent run; both via `transport/amc_client.py`.
- [ ] `amc.mark_read` calls are idempotent on `message_id` and safe to retry.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Worker crash mid-turn (exception during `agent.run`): log, send error reply to channel, mark message read, do NOT crash the dispatcher.
- [ ] Long-running turn (>60s): handler already ACKed at 204; worker continues independently.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] AMC `RATE_LIMITED`: transparent (sleep `Retry-After`, retry send).
- [ ] AMC `PLATFORM_AUTH`: log Logfire alert, do not retry, send a "Capo can't reach AMC — check your bearer token" message via fallback (or skip if AMC unreachable).
- [ ] AMC `CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND`: mark delegation orphaned, do not retry; reply text "I can't reach that channel anymore" if possible.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: per-channel ordering preserved
• Unit: unknown sender rejected with clear log
• Integration: parallel channels don't block each other
• Integration: worker exception → error reply sent + message marked read + dispatcher alive

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.2, 5.11, 9.1, 15.3
